alerts.headline: Tornado Warning for parts of Central Oklahoma
alerts.description: The National Weather Service has issued a Tornado Warning for Central Oklahoma including Oklahoma City metro. A severe thunderstorm capable of producing a tornado has been detected. Take shelter immediately.

alerts.headline: Severe Thunderstorm Watch for Houston area
alerts.description: The National Weather Service has issued a Severe Thunderstorm Watch for the Houston metropolitan area. Conditions are favorable for severe thunderstorms through this evening.

alerts.headline: Flash Flood Warning for Miami-Dade County
alerts.description: The National Weather Service has issued a Flash Flood Warning for Miami-Dade County. Heavy rainfall has caused flash flooding. Do not attempt to drive through flooded roadways.

alerts.headline: Wind Advisory for Chicago area
alerts.description: The National Weather Service has issued a Wind Advisory for the Chicago area. North winds 20-30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph expected. Secure loose outdoor objects.

alerts.headline: Frost Advisory for Denver metro
alerts.description: The National Weather Service has issued a Frost Advisory for the Denver metro area. Temperatures expected to drop near freezing tonight. Protect sensitive vegetation.
